top_signals.title: Oil Climbs as Saudi East-West Pipeline Remains Offline
top_signals.summary: Oil rose for a second day with a critical Saudi Arabian pipeline still offline. The East-West conduit — a workaround for Strait of Hormuz flows — was shut last week after attacks, with Saudi Aramco yet to say when it may restart. Tyler Kendall reports on Bloomberg Television. (Source: Bloomberg)
